name: ada-title-ii-pdf-auditor
title: ADA Title II & PDF/UA-1 Public Document Auditor
description: Crawls municipal, university, transit, and public websites (including /DocumentCenter & .pdf endpoints) and audits every discovered PDF against ISO 14289-1 (PDF/UA-1) and WCAG 2.1 AA with pass scores, severity ratings, and fixed-fee remediation estimates.
